verdict.rationale: Letta is an agent product that can work over a user's own data inside the product. Cloud agents can explore connected repositories and sweep bug reports, `/init` inspects a repository, and `/doctor` audits memory for drift, duplication and token usage. These are AI analyses of user data, but there is no documented dedicated insights or proactive-suggestions feature beyond asking the agent. Missing for 10: a documented insights/suggestions surface, proactive recommendations drawn from user data, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: agents running on cloud computers can access your repositories to do work — sweeping bug reports, opening pull requests, or exploring your codebase.
Run `/init` to bootstrap or refresh memory for the current project. The agent inspects the repository, asks about your working style when needed
If the memory hierarchy has drifted or grown too large, run /doctor to audit placement, duplication, and system-prompt token usage.
Dreaming uses background subagents to review recent conversations, consolidate useful lessons, and update memory without interrupting your active work.
